about: list rows (ui/components/list): sizes as CSS variables. Rows are one even pill each: title and sub line on one line apiece, cut with an ellipsis, full text in the tooltip. wrap:true rows (dense reading): wider, text wraps in full, title 13px and sub 11.5px: size A, the user's pick on 11-13 (docs/theme-rules.md 12c; min 12.5/11.5, max 17/14).
